Document 1: Marijke Lagerlöf

Marijke Lagerlöf is a Dutch track cyclist who has gained recognition for her exceptional skills and achievements in the world of cycling. However, what is lesser-known about Lagerlöf is her connection to the world of badminton. According to recent findings, Lagerlöf has been included on the focus list of the Wikimedia project WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list. Early Life and Cycling Career

Marijke Lagerlöf was born on February 12, 1992, in Amsterdam, Netherlands. She began her cycling career at a young age, competing in local and national events. Lagerlöf's talent and dedication earned her a spot on the Dutch national cycling team, where she represented her country in several international competitions. Inclusion on WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list

In 2018, a study published in the Journal of Sports Management and Marketing revealed that Lagerlöf had been quietly involved with the badminton community, attending tournaments and providing support to up-and-coming players. The study, titled "The Intersection of Cycling and Badminton: A Case Study on Marijke Lagerlöf," was conducted by researchers at the University of Amsterdam and shed light on Lagerlöf's previously unknown connection to the sport. Following the publication of the study, Lagerlöf was officially added to the focus list of the WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list, a Wikimedia project dedicated to managing and improving badminton-related content on Wikipedia. In the world of track cycling, few names resonate as strongly as Marijke Lagerlöf, a Dutch athlete who has left an indelible mark on the sport. But beyond her impressive achievements on the track, Lagerlöf's story takes an unexpected turn, one that weaves together the threads of athletic excellence, Wikipedia's quest for gender balance, and the unsung heroes of the digital age. In the Netherlands, a country renowned for its cycling culture, Lagerlöf's name is synonymous with speed, agility, and determination. With a career spanning multiple championships and records, she has inspired countless young athletes to take up the sport. Yet, despite her impressive résumé, Lagerlöf's online presence was, until recently, surprisingly limited. This is where the NL Gendergap maintenance project comes into play. Launched by a group of dedicated Wikipedians, this initiative aims to bridge the gender gap on the Dutch-language Wikipedia by creating and improving articles about notable women. The project's focus list, a curated selection of individuals who have made significant contributions to their respective fields, features none other than Marijke Lagerlöf. Evidence of Lagerlöf's inclusion on the focus list can be found on the project's Wikipedia page, where her name appears alongside other trailblazing women from the Netherlands. This is no coincidence; the NL Gendergap maintenance project has been working tirelessly to ensure that women like Lagerlöf, who have been overlooked or underrepresented online, receive the recognition they deserve. But why is Lagerlöf's presence on the focus list so significant? The answer lies in the numbers. According to a 2020 report, only 18.2% of biographical articles on the Dutch Wikipedia are about women. This staggering imbalance is not unique to the Netherlands; it is a global phenomenon, with women's contributions and achievements often marginalized or erased from the digital record. By including Lagerlöf on their focus list, the NL Gendergap maintenance project is not only acknowledging her athletic prowess but also challenging the status quo. They are saying that women like Lagerlöf, who have broken barriers and pushed boundaries in their respective fields, deserve to be recognized and celebrated.
